name: Yuxiang
source:
We walk together, play together, and do everything together. This is our last trip, our last memory. It is a short visual novel contains three story lines, after main story the other two will be unlocked. Which one is your side of story?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/880400/Lingering_Fragrance/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们一起走路，一起玩耍，一起做所有事情。这是我们最后一次旅行，也是我们最后的回忆。这是一部包含三条故事线的短篇视觉小说，完成主线后会解锁另外两条。哪一条才是属于你的故事？

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/880400/Lingering_Fragrance/]Steam[/url]）
